method: Static source/memory review plus historicalHPID verification; no PartCATSeg predictions or synthetic all42 inference consumed.
component_policy: Every8connected component retained; no area cutoffs.
efficiency: One global int32 component map plus one temporary scipy connected-component map; no full-image Boolean array per component.
IoU matrix computed with component-area/intersection bincounts. Memory is O(imagePixels + nTruth*nComponents), not O(imagePixels*nComponents).
Canonical semantic-union masks allocated per present semantic class, independent of component count.
Hungarian matching runs once per case and assignments are reused for0.25/0.50/0.75 thresholds.
Only one case evaluated at a time; no all42 image arrays retained. Per-case outputs keep lightweight scalar results and component-to-label index lists.
remaining_limits: Highly fragmented predictions can create many components and larger Hungarian matrices/JSON lists, but do not create one image-sized mask per component. These counts must be retained; no after-the-fact small-component removal. CPU time is not a reason to exclude a case.
